title: GDeflate: GPU-optimized DEFLATE compression format
relevance: Defines the GDeflate format: a bit-swizzled version of DEFLATE that extracts 32-way parallelism for GPU decompression while maintaining identical compression ratios.

title: Introducing Iguana: extremely fast SIMD-optimized decompression
relevance: Demonstrates 13 GB/s single-core decompression using AVX-512 VBMI2 instructions with a custom SIMD-friendly format. Novel encoding design for full SIMD utilization.

title: A General SIMD-based Approach to Accelerating Compression Algorithms
relevance: General framework for applying SIMD to compression algorithms, including integer compression methods that share concepts with Huffman decode.

title: SIMDflate: Experimental speed-oriented DEFLATE implementation based on AVX-512
relevance: Experimental AVX-512 DEFLATE implementation focused on text compression. Demonstrates SIMD application to standard DEFLATE format.
